wiki.summary: Fortworth is a Collaboration between Drake and PartyNextDoor following their 2025 collaboration album $ome $exy $ongs for you. Party has been a frequent collaborator on Drake solo albums, most recently appearing on Members Only off For all the Dogs. Read more on Last.fm.
